<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ホス：メイン・パワー・ジェネレーター　第１マーカー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">“ホス・エネルギー・シールド・ルール”が適用される。ここにある自分の固定兵器は動力の供給を受ける。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">“ホス・エネルギー・シールド・ルール”が適用される。“壊滅”したなら、ライトサイドは８フォースを失う。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-Main-Power-Generators-1st-Marker-PSA-148375105.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Main Power Generators, 1st Marker.

'''Light Side:'''
'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' apply. Your artillery weapons here are powered.

'''Dark Side:'''
'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' apply. If 'destroyed,' the Light Side loses 8 Force.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese Dark side uses 壊滅 for the blown-away result.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
